hooks.name: Auto Commit and Push on Save
hooks.description: Automatically commits and pushes all changes to GitHub after each file save

action.command: cd "c:\Users\rnmdr\OneDrive\Documents\study-notes" && git add . && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "auto-save: update $(date +%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)" && git push origin main
